title: Item:Sentient Jewel of the Kobold
wikitext:
{{Consumable
  | picdesc     = Sentient Jewel of the Kobold.png
  | acquired    = Tolero
  | location    = [[House Phiarlan]], during the [[Anniversary Party]] Event. (starting with the [[12th Anniversary]] Event)
  | turnin      = 250 {{Item|Party Favor}}s
  | minlevel    = 20
  | bind        = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}
  | effect      = A jewel that holds [[Sentient Weapon|sentient power]].
  | cost        = 500 pp
  | weight      = 0.01 lbs
  | stack       = <!-- Stack size for this consumable - default 100 -->
  | description = A jewel that holds sentient power. Click on the Sentient Item button on the right side of the inventory panel (or drag a weapon to that slot) to open the sentient Item panel.
  | Category1   = Anniversary Party reward items
  | notes       = Voiced by [[Cindy Robinson]].
:* On first slotting
:: (Say): "I awaken..."
:* On feeding
:: (Say): "Mmm! Feed me more shinies!"
:* On equiping
:: (Say): "Kobold still hate you."
:: (Say): "Your hands stink. Like tall person!"
:: (Say): "Don't squeeze so hard. Kobold not comfortable with this."
:* On unequiping
:: (Say): "This is best part. Kobold nap time!"
:* On opening a chest
:: (Say): "Oooooh, what's that?"
:: (Say): "Kobold smell shinies!"
:: (Say): "Look... a thing-a-ma-thing!"
:: (Say): "Nice!... Kobold still hate you." ''(2 diff readings)''
:: (Say): "Nice move! Don't forget to use your tail!"
:: (Say): "Yip yip hurray!"
:: (Say): "Booyah!"
:: (Say): "You're amazing!... not really."
:: (Say): "Yippie!"
:* On gaining a filigree slot
:: (Say): "Oooo ... Shiny!"
:* On removing the Sentient Jewel:
:: (Say): "No! The heart of my power! Don't..."
:* On quest completion / turn-in:
:: (Say): "You all done now? Then find Kobold more shinies!"
:* On picking up a quest
:: (Say): "Tell me we not killing Kobolds in a sewer again."
:* On being critically wounded / near death
:: (Say): "If you die, how Kobold get back home? ... PANIC!"
:* On resurection
:: (Say): "Good. You were starting to smell!"
:* Upon killing an enemy: 
:: (Say): "Kobold covered in somebody else's blood. "
:: (Say): "Not that one! It was kind of cute"
:: (Say): "Wheeeeeee!"
:* When shrining:
:: (Say): "You rest, master. Kobold will stand watch. ''<laughs>'' Ahahaha! Just kidding."
:: (Say): "Time to close eyes and dream of big juicy rats and shinies."
:* Being hit by a trap:
:: (Say): "Kobold almost liked you. Then this happened."
:: (Say): "Kobold not happy with some of your life choices."
:: (Say): "Kobold embarassed to be seen with you right now."
:: (Say): "Really? Really?!"
:: (Say): "Kaboooooooom!"
:: (Say): "Yark!"
:: (Say): "Nooo!"
:* Disabling Traps:
:: (Say): "Oh well. Maybe trap get you next time."
:* When injured:
:: (Say): "What's wrong? You acting funny, even for tall stupid person."
:: (Say): "Don't just stand there. Jump out of the way, like Kobold!"
:* When a party member dies:
:: (Say): "Are you trying to kill your friends on purpose? Kobold can help!"
:* Unknown:
:: (Say): "What's that? Smells like ...  Secrets!"
:* When adding a filigree:
:: (Say): "Yippie!"
:: (Say): "You're amazing! Not really."
:: (Say): "Yip yip hurray!"
}}
